_comment: Passive Abilities (data/kits.json gives each line two; equip one). 'effect' picks the engine hook in scripts/brawler.gd; the other fields are its numbers. Rule of thumb: always-on bonuses about 8% or less, conditional ones up to 20%.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: Fire moves deal 20% more below a third of your HP

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Water moves deal 20% more below a third of your HP

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: Grass moves deal 20% more below a third of your HP

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: Bug moves deal 20% more below a third of your HP

effect_spore.name: Effect Spore
effect_spore.desc: Close-range attackers may fall asleep for a moment (15%)

rough_skin.name: Rough Skin
rough_skin.desc: Close-range attackers take 18% of the damage they deal

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: Once per life, survive a knockout hit with 1 HP (if you had over a quarter of your HP)

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.desc: Out-of-combat healing starts 1.2 s sooner and is 25% faster

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: When you spawn or evolve, lowers nearby enemies' Attack for 4 s

speed_boost.name: Speed Boost
speed_boost.desc: In a fight, +4% speed every 2 s (up to 20%)

technician.name: Technician
technician.desc: Multi-shot and burst attacks deal 12% more

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: Hits on targets more than 5 m away deal 10% more

iron_fist.name: Iron Fist
iron_fist.desc: Punches, kicks and chops deal 15% more

guts.name: Guts
guts.desc: 20% more damage while you have a status condition

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: Attacks deal 12% more but reload 10% slower

shed_skin.name: Shed Skin
shed_skin.desc: Every 3 s, a 35% chance to shake off your status

serene_grace.name: Serene Grace
serene_grace.desc: Your moves' status chances are doubled

inner_focus.name: Inner Focus
inner_focus.desc: Stuns and sleep on you last half as long

thick_fat.name: Thick Fat
thick_fat.desc: Take 25% less from Fire and Ice moves

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: Half damage from Ground moves, floats over traps, and 5% faster

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: Enemies you hit charge their super 20% slower for 2.5 s
